Published: 🚀 Added per-dispatch store selection to the KMP, App Store and Play Store publish workflows, with a shared rule deciding which publisher runs; unselected stores skip cleanly and report a "skipped" status to Telegram

🚀 Added an App Store-only publish dispatch with a no-submit mode, so a failed App Store publish can be retried without republishing to Play, plus a Telegram report for prepared but unsubmitted versions

🐛 Fixed App Store Connect app lookup to match the exact bundle ID, resolving a publish failure caused by a similarly named debug app; also kept the existing release type on editable versions and stripped emoji that App Store Connect rejects from What's New
🔧 Re-enabled the KMP iOS release build and App Store publish trigger on the free macos-26 runner, restoring iOS results in notifications and release assets, and updated the docs

Testing: 🚀 Started integrating the Chatwoot support chat SDK into the app
🔧 Fixed a build issue by adding a Kotlin metadata dependency so Hilt can read the Chatwoot SDK
🔧 Added CI workflows to dispatch debug and release builds and Play Store publishing to the central actions repo
🔧 Added a scheduled job to clean up debug releases and tags older than 4 days
🌐 Added a translated "Chat with support" string across many languages to support the new chat feature

Published: 🚀 Added catalog model animations and a local review flow for catalog models
📝 Published the automated daily health report for 2026-11-07
🚀 Published a maritime security story on Iran-linked ships circling undersea cable routes in the Gulf of Oman, with newsletter and Telegram alert sent
🚀 Published a NATO story on the HMS Prince of Wales-led strike group in the High North, including the Neptune Strike exercise and an F-35B intercept, and sent the newsletter
🚀 Published incident reports: a crew fatality aboard tanker Whitchallenger at Southampton, the BYB Othello grounding at the Bosphorus entrance, and the sanctioned tanker Alyssum towed to Port Said
🔧 Updated the cover image generation script's default model to a supported version to prevent failures on future runs
🔧 Release workflow now picks app stores per merged PR: no-android skips Google Play, no-ios skips the App Store, and no label publishes to both
🔧 Manual release runs can republish an existing release tag to selected stores
🐛 Merged the iOS support chat fix, which generates all iOS client config from local.properties
📝 Updated docs on CI retriggers, app lookup and release-type handling, on safely updating branches in Android Studio, and on iOS 26.2 runtime recovery
Testing: 🐛 Fixed common test storage fakes to throw okio.IOException so iOS simulator tests compile, with Android behavior unchanged
🔧 Merged main into the overlay feature branch, resolving onboarding video conflicts and updating media resource tests
